story.vex: A shift cipher again? You're not even trying. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The same trick that broke Vex's cipher can't touch the crew's new one. Astro: "A weak cipher falls to patience. A strong one needs the key, full stop."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Doom's codebreakers are testing our old shift cipher. Break their intercepted message the same way they'd break ours, then upgrade the crew to a stronger cipher they can't shift their way through.

1. type old-intercept.txt
2. try shifts with caesar decode until it reads as English (hint: most common letter in the ciphertext is likely 'E')
3. submit the decoded message
4. xor citadel-shield-9 UPGRADE COMPLETE
5. submit the ciphertext
files.C:\\Citadel\\old-intercept.txt:
A weak shift cipher — the kind Vex breaks by counting letters. Shift unknown; try a few.

AJC HFSSTY GWJFP YMNX

steps.title: Break the weak cipher
steps.body: Volt: "A shift cipher falls to patience: count the letters, guess the shift, try it." Read `old-intercept.txt`, then try `caesar decode <shift> AJC HFSSTY GWJFP YMNX` for a few shifts until it reads as English. Submit the decoded message.

steps.title: Upgrade to a real cipher
steps.body: Rivet: "A shift cipher only has 25 possible keys. Ours needs a real one." Run `xor citadel-shield-9 UPGRADE COMPLETE` and submit the ciphertext. Without the key, counting letters gets Doom nowhere this time.
